_instructions: Dominion Energy Virginia (Virginia Electric and Power Company). Parameters sourced from SCC Case PUR-2025-00058 (final order November 2025), PJM BRA reports 2025, Dominion 10-K 2025, and Schedule 1 tariff effective January 2026. Six fields marked _VERIFY require confirmation from the SCC rate case filing before results should be trusted.
name: Virginia Electric and Power Company (Dominion Energy Virginia)
territory: Most of Virginia and parts of North Carolina
filing_case: SCC Case PUR-2025-00058 (biennial review, final order November 2025, rates effective January 2026 and January 2027)
_rate_base_VERIFY: Dominion's total electric rate base includes generation, transmission, and distribution. Model requires distribution-only rate base for NWS analysis. Total electric rate base estimated at $36-40B from 10-K; distribution-only estimated at 25-30% of total (~$9-11B). NEEDS VERIFICATION FROM SCC RATE CASE FILING.
_capex_VERIFY: Total 2026-2030 capital plan ~$55B ($11B/yr average) including generation, offshore wind, and transmission. Distribution-only CAPEX estimated at 20-25% of total (~$2.2-2.75B/yr). NWS-eligible share lower than NY utilities — large share is transmission-driven or compliance-driven. NEEDS VERIFICATION FROM SCC FILING AND IRP.
_revenue_VERIFY: SCC approved base rate revenue increases of $565.7M for 2026 and $209.9M for 2027. Total electric revenue requirement including all riders estimated at $8-10B. NEEDS VERIFICATION FROM SCC FILING.
_tariff_note: Schedule 1 (Residential Service) effective January 2026. Basic customer charge $7.58/month. Blended all-in rate approximately 14.67 cents/kWh. Virginia is partially restructured — majority of customers take bundled service. Delivery and supply split estimated from SCC filing; riders (fuel, offshore wind, grid transformation) add significantly to the blended rate.
_capacity_note: PJM DOM zone is transmission-constrained due to data centre concentration in Northern Virginia. 2025/2026 BRA: DOM zone cleared at $444.26/MW-day vs $269.92 RTO-wide. 2026/2027 BRA: DOM zone cleared at $329.17/MW-day (system-wide cap). Anchor: $329.17 x 365 / 1,000,000 = $0.120M/MW-year. Growth assumption higher than NYISO (5%/yr real) reflecting data centre load tightening reserve margins. Sources: PJM 2025/2026 BRA Report July 2024; PJM 2026/2027 BRA Report July 2025.
_property_tax_VERIFY: Virginia utility property assessed by local commissioners of revenue. Effective rates vary by locality. Estimated 1.5-2.0% of distribution rate base. NEEDS VERIFICATION FROM DOMINION ANNUAL REPORT OR SCC TESTIMONY.
_nws_VERIFY: NWS eligibility lower than NY utilities: large share of CAPEX is transmission not distribution; offshore wind and CVOW are not NWS-addressable; data centre driven transmission upgrades (89 projects per 2024 IRP) are not distribution NWS. Starting estimate 20-25% of total CAPEX is distribution NWS-eligible. MOST UNCERTAIN PARAMETER — review against IRP capital breakdown before modelling.
_dist_upgrade_VERIFY: Northern Virginia (data centre corridor) has dense suburban/urban network approaching Con Edison cost levels. Rest of Dominion territory predominantly overhead suburban and rural, similar to RG&E. Blended estimate $1.5-2.0M/MW. NEEDS VERIFICATION FROM SCC CAPITAL FILINGS.
